verdict.rationale: QuickBooks Online exposes a well-documented REST API (SDKs, OAuth client) and an official MCP server claiming 145 tools with full CRUD across 29 entity types and 11 financial reports, indicating broad programmatic coverage of core accounting objects (invoices, bills, expenses, reports). However there is no explicit claim or evidence of 1:1 parity with every UI feature (e.g., Intuit Intelligence chat actions, Payroll AI, bank-feed matching rules, sales-channel integrations, forecasting tools) being reachable via API, and probes show no public OpenAPI spec or llms.txt confirming completeness. Missing for 10: explicit vendor statement or independent verification of full UI-API parity, API coverage for AI-chat/payroll/forecasting features, and confirmation that write operations aren't gated (MCP even ships a QUICKBOOKS_DISABLE_WRITE flag suggesting some write restrictions by default).
